steps.motion: tiny little circular strokes, then lift

steps.subject: mountain

steps.subject: mountain

steps.motion: scrape off the excess, firm pressure

steps.subject: mist
steps.action: tap a little mist and lift upward
steps.motion: tap a little bit of mist, give it upward lift

steps.subject: mountain
steps.action: layer more foothills, darker forward

steps.subject: evergreen

steps.motion: tap downward

steps.motion: tap downward, don't make them all even
steps.rule: Otherwise they would look like fence posts.

steps.motion: grab it and pull straight down, then very lightly across

steps.motion: push very firmly, cut straight
steps.rule: Otherwise the water will appear to run.

steps.subject: far trees

steps.motion: touch the corner, work back and forth, bend bristles down
steps.rule: This allows light to be lifted toward the sun.

steps.subject: leaf tree

steps.load: one direction, pull firmly through the paint
steps.motion: pull, rounded corner toward the top

steps.motion: scrape in many small things
